text:
## Overview Process  
```
Customer Requests Address Change
↓
Verify Customer Identity
↓
Identify All Affected Accounts
↓
Collect New Address Details
↓
Verify New Address (Proof of Address)
↓
Update KYC Records
↓
Assess AML Risk (New Address/Country)
↓
AML Screening (if high-risk)
↓
Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)
↓
Update Statement Delivery
↓
Update Communications (Email/Phone/Post)
↓
Notify Customer of Change
↓
Close Change Request
```  
**Timeline:** 2-5 business days (depending on proof of address requirement)

raw_entities.name: Change of Address Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for processing a customer's request to change their registered address. The process includes identity verification, collection of new address details, proof of address verification, KYC record updates, AML risk assessment, and system updates across all banking platforms. Completion timeline is 2-5 business days depending on proof of address requirements.
context: Timeline: 2-5 business days (depending on proof of address requirement)

raw_entities.name: Customer Address Change Request Reception
raw_entities.description: Initial step where a customer initiates a request to change their registered address on file.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification step to confirm the identity of the customer requesting the address change before proceeding with the update.

raw_entities.name: Affected Account Identification
raw_entities.description: Step to identify and list all customer accounts that will be affected by the address change across all products and services.

raw_entities.name: New Address Details Collection
raw_entities.description: Collection of the customer's new address information including all required address components.

raw_entities.name: New Address Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification step where the customer's new address is validated through acceptable proof of address documentation.

raw_entities.name: KYC Records Update
raw_entities.description: Update of Know Your Customer records to reflect the verified new address across the customer's profile.

raw_entities.name: AML Risk Assessment for Address Change
raw_entities.description: Assessment of Anti-Money Laundering risk implications based on the new address and potentially the new country of residence.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Execution
raw_entities.description: Execution of AML screening checks when the risk assessment indicates high-risk factors associated with the new address or country.

raw_entities.name: Core and Payment System Updates
raw_entities.description: Update of the customer's address across all core banking systems, standing order systems, direct debit systems, and data warehouse platforms.
context: Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)

raw_entities.name: Statement Delivery Address Update
raw_entities.description: Update of the address used for delivery of account statements and other periodic correspondence.

raw_entities.name: Communications Channel Address Update
raw_entities.description: Update of the customer's address across all communication channels including email, phone, and postal address records.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification of Address Change
raw_entities.description: Notification sent to the customer confirming that their address change has been successfully processed and updated across all systems.

raw_entities.name: Change Request Closure
raw_entities.description: Final step to close and archive the address change request in the system upon successful completion of all updates.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Representative
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for receiving and processing the customer's address change request, collecting new address details, and managing the overall change request workflow.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Officer
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for verifying customer identity, assessing AML risk based on the new address and country, and determining whether AML screening is required.

raw_entities.name: Operations Staff
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for updating the customer's address across all core banking systems, standing order systems, direct debit systems, data warehouse, and statement delivery platforms.
context: Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)

raw_entities.name: AML Risk Level Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision point where the AML risk assessment determines whether the new address and country present high-risk factors that require full AML screening before proceeding.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint where proof of address documentation must be verified and validated before KYC records can be updated.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint triggered when AML risk assessment indicates high-risk factors, requiring AML screening completion before system updates proceed.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: KYC verification process for the customer's new address, including collection and validation of proof of address documentation.

raw_entities.name: Address-Based AML Screening
raw_entities.description: AML screening process triggered when the customer's new address or country of residence presents elevated risk factors requiring sanctions and PEP list checks.

raw_entities.name: New Address Recording
raw_entities.description: The customer's new address collected, verified, and recorded across all banking systems as part of the address change process.
context: Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address
raw_entities.description: Documentation required to verify and validate the customer's new address as part of the KYC verification process.

raw_entities.name: Individual Customer
raw_entities.description: The customer initiating the address change request and subject to identity verification, KYC updates, and AML risk assessment throughout the process.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Standing order payment instructions on the customer's account that must be updated to reflect the new address in the system.
context: Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Mandate
raw_entities.description: Direct debit mandates on the customer's account that must be updated to reflect the new address in the system.
context: Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)

properties.purpose: Enable customers to update their registered address across all accounts and systems
properties.scope: All individual customers with active accounts
properties.outcome_success: Address updated across all systems, customer notified, change request closed
properties.outcome_failure: Address change rejected due to AML risk or verification failure; customer notified of reason

properties.output: Change request logged with timestamp and customer details
Identity verified and confirmed in system
List of all accounts linked to customer (savings, current, joint, standing orders, direct debits)
New address details captured and recorded

properties.input: New address details and proof of address documentation
properties.failure_path: Request escalated to Compliance Officer for manual review or customer asked to provide alternative proof

properties.input: Verified new address and customer identity confirmation
properties.output: KYC records updated with new address and verification date

properties.name: AML Risk Assessment for Address Change

properties.input: New address, customer risk profile, country of residence
properties.output: AML risk level determination (low, medium, high)

properties.failure_path: If hit detected, escalate to senior compliance for investigation and potential SAR filing

properties.input: Verified new address and affected account list
properties.output: Address updated in core banking system, standing orders, direct debits, and payment systems
Statement delivery address updated for all affected accounts
Email, phone, and postal address updated in communications system
Customer notified of successful address change via preferred channel

properties.input: Confirmation of all updates and customer notification
properties.output: Change request marked as closed with completion timestamp

properties.decision_question: Does the new address present a high AML risk?
properties.path_yes: Escalate to senior compliance for investigation; potential SAR filing; customer may be notified of delay
properties.path_no: Proceed to system updates and customer notification

evidence_required: Proof of address document (utility bill, council tax, bank statement)
properties.failure_consequence: Address change request rejected; customer must provide alternative proof or escalated to Compliance Officer
If hit detected: investigation required, potential SAR filing, account may be frozen pending clearance

properties.consequence_of_failure: Address change request rejected; customer must provide alternative proof

properties.hit_or_match_response: Escalate to senior compliance for investigation; potential SAR filing; freeze account pending clearance

collection_steps: Address verified with proof of address (Step 5)
Customer provides proof document during address change request (Step 4-5)

properties.eligibility_or_verification_status: Must have verified identity and active account(s)

properties.setup_or_amendment_process: Address change triggers standing order system update (Step 9)
properties.beneficiary_validation: Beneficiary address may be affected; review required if beneficiary address matches customer address

properties.mandate_process: Address change triggers direct debit system update (Step 9); mandate remains valid with updated address
